v18Closure.rule: A historical issue/label never reopens v18. A fresh current-main regression with no later superseding evidence must be added here as a named corrective blocker before v19 implementation can start.

requirements.requirement: Market Intelligence protected benchmark/breadth freshness, recovery and truthful unavailable-vs-zero behavior remains closed by v18.8.2 evidence.
requirements.canonicalOwner: existing allocator + canonical freshness/recovery + Market Intelligence consumer
requirements.evidence: Issue #57 closed completed after v18.8.2 qualification/release path.

requirements.requirement: v18 provider-intelligence and professional closure remain complete with no unexplained actionable product residual.
requirements.evidence: #65 and #107 closed completed; main continuity green.

requirements.requirement: Provider rights metadata covers commercial/multi-user use, server-side proxying, caching/retention, redistribution/display, derived/AI use, concurrency/user/device limits, attribution, plan/environment restrictions and effective/expiry/renewal state.
Provider rights are evidence-bound, fail closed and runtime-enforceable; a working key never implies commercial, redistribution or AI permission.
requirements.canonicalOwner: provider rights policy layered over existing Router/cache/persistence/serving owners

requirements.requirement: Provider-right downgrade/expiry deterministically changes allowed cache/persistence/REST/live behavior including retain/delete/quarantine/derived-only/block semantics.
One upstream fetch may satisfy multiple users only when licensing, product entitlement and tenant isolation all permit reuse.
First-class tenant/account context scopes hosted requests, data and metrics and remains distinct from user/device/session identity.
requirements.canonicalOwner: existing identity owner extended for hosted tenant context

requirements.requirement: Device registration includes identity, naming, last-seen, revoke/lost-device workflow and stale retirement.
Session expiry, refresh and revocation take effect promptly across API, native, SSE and WebSocket paths.
requirements.canonicalOwner: existing session security owner extended for hosted operation

requirements.requirement: SUPER_OWNER/OWNER and privileged ADMIN sensitive actions use stronger re-authentication/MFA/passkey-class controls plus governed recovery.
Canonical SUPER_OWNER / OWNER / ADMIN / USER / DEMO plus capability authorization is enforced consistently; ADMIN is never blanket authority.
Direct API/route authorization matches UI composition; PostgreSQL RLS may be defense-in-depth but is never the sole authorization layer.
DE.PULSE customer product entitlement is a separate control from tenant identity, RBAC and upstream provider rights.
Plan/status/feature entitlement, quota dimensions, grace/suspension/disabled behavior and upgrade/downgrade semantics are deterministic.
Metering/consumption truth is billing-provider agnostic and cannot be inferred from provider entitlement.
Account/product data inventory and classification record purpose, consumer, minimization and retention by data class.
Account/user review/export, deactivation/deletion and durable tombstone semantics are executable product behavior.
Deletion/expiry semantics cover PostgreSQL, sync logs, native SQLite working sets, caches and backups/PITR according to policy without deleting shared immutable market evidence improperly.
Audit/log retention and minimization, support/operator access boundaries/auditability and data-residency/region disposition are explicit.
Dev/test/stage/prod environments are isolated and production tenant data is not casually reused in non-production.
Infrastructure/configuration desired state, service identities, ingress/egress/network/TLS boundaries, least privilege and environment-specific secret references are versioned.
Reproducible environment bootstrap/deploy, configuration drift detection, rollback/fail-forward and deployment-state provenance are executable.
PostgreSQL is shared hosted authority only for sync-eligible tenant/account state and lawful hosted evidence; no raw SQLite table replication or dual-master ownership.
requirements.canonicalOwner: canonical persistence manager + PostgreSQL hosted backend

requirements.requirement: Tenant isolation, schema/migration ownership, bounded pool/index/transaction/capacity controls are defined and measured.
HA/failover, encrypted backups, PITR, restore drills, expand/contract migration, rollback/roll-forward, RPO/RTO and partial-outage behavior are proven.
Server recovery rollback cannot corrupt native SQLite or duplicate/lose acknowledged client mutations beyond the frozen RPO contract.

Normal commercial users are zero-key; provider credentials live only in canonical server-side managed secret/KMS ownership and never in SQLite, ordinary PostgreSQL sync rows, browser storage, normal logs, telemetry or sync payloads.
Owner/developer standalone local-key mode, if retained, remains isolated in existing local secret/OS secure-store ownership and hosted user mode never silently falls back to an embedded key.
requirements.canonicalOwner: existing local Secrets owner + hosted mode policy

requirements.requirement: Staged secret rotation/rollback, emergency compromise revoke, health validation, least privilege, audited administration and no plaintext leak work without client rebuild/redeploy.
Direct/transitive dependency inventory, trusted source/license policy, vulnerability/advisory scanning and SBOM where applicable are executable.
Build/artifact integrity, signing/attestation/provenance where practical, source→build→artifact→environment traceability and vulnerable component patch/update/revoke process are executable.
Provider quality/cost/coverage/SLO scorecards use measured health, freshness, latency, disagreement, headroom, rights, cost and usefulness without becoming a second routing owner.
Revision/reconciliation/provenance and no-lookahead point-in-time data quality are canonical before historical/adaptive evidence expands.
Hosted API/stream inventory has explicit version boundary, compatibility matrix, deprecation/removal policy, supported protocol/client range and truthful unsupported-client behavior.

Authenticated Hosted Provider Gateway is a deployment boundary around existing canonical owners; Smart Provider Router v2 remains sole provider router and normal clients never call providers using platform credentials.
requirements.canonicalOwner: hosted gateway adapter over Smart Provider Router v2

requirements.requirement: Hosted serving applies tenant/account → session/device → RBAC/capability → product entitlement → provider rights → freshness/data class → cache/persistence → exact residual Router need in distinguishable fail-closed stages.
Entitlement-aware cache/persistence lookup and projection cannot leak higher-tier/right-restricted data to a lower-entitled account/user.
Zero-key covers WebSocket/SSE/live subscriptions; existing multi-feed subscription owner is reused server-side and downstream fan-out is tenant/product/right authorized.
requirements.canonicalOwner: existing multi-feed subscription owner + hosted fan-out adapter

requirements.requirement: Role/status/device/product-right revocation or downgrade promptly terminates or re-authorizes long-lived streams.
Per account/user/device/capability quotas, throttling and abuse controls coexist with upstream provider limits and protected live-session capacity.
Sync is typed, application-level, incremental, idempotent, checkpointed and domain-aware; raw SQLite↔PostgreSQL mirroring is prohibited.
Stable entity ID, tenant/account/user/device attribution, base revision, schema/protocol/domain version and provenance/rights classification are required before a domain activates.
Eligible local mutation and durable SQLite outbox intent are atomic; idempotency scope/lifetime, request fingerprint and duplicate replay are deterministic across restart.

Server transactionally applies mutation, records authoritative tenant-scoped sequence/revision and client checkpoint advances only after durable local apply; wall-clock time is never sole order authority.
Brand-new/stale device bootstrap uses consistent snapshot/page stream + server high-watermark + transactional local apply + delta continuation and non-destructive re-bootstrap.
Change-log/tombstone retention and compaction are bounded and offline-safe; inactive-device expiry is explicit and deletion is never inferred from absence after compaction.
Optimistic concurrency plus domain-specific deterministic conflict handling replaces universal last-write-wins for preferences, watchlists, desks, notes and evidence.
Mixed-version negotiation publishes min/current/max protocol and capability/domain versions; unsupported mutation rejection preserves durable client outbox and truthful upgrade path.

Ordinary sync excludes transient UI/runtime state, ephemeral market snapshots/caches, machine process state, logs/crash artifacts, raw provider keys and session refresh secrets unless separately governed.
Shared capabilities are completed across Mac + Windows + Web together; one-platform pilot/catch-up sequencing is superseded and material parity debt blocks advancement.
Native SQLite is tenant/account scoped; sign-out/user switch cannot expose another account; local session/device credentials use OS secure storage and lost/revoked device network access is blocked.
Portable preferences converge deterministically across Mac/Windows/Web.
Watchlists/Master Symbols converge across Mac/Windows/Web with canonical membership/tombstone semantics and no second symbol owner.
requirements.canonicalOwner: existing Master Symbol/watchlist owner + sync adapter

requirements.requirement: Desks/workspaces and portable configuration converge across Mac/Windows/Web with deterministic membership/config/delete behavior.
Saved searches/notes/product-owned research state use revision/history/conflict behavior that prevents silent destructive overwrite.
Lawful, entitled, provenance-bound durable research/evidence is portable without exposing restricted evidence or deleting shared immutable market truth with account deletion.
Discovery/Opportunity Radar is cross-platform through canonical shared processing rather than per-client intelligence forks.
Market State/Market Modes/Readiness/Explanations have equivalent meaning across clients while deterministic Day/Swing/Long and Market Mode ownership remains protected.
Settings/account/device controls are cross-platform and zero-key normal users never receive provider-secret configuration machinery.
RBAC/product-entitlement UX is equivalent across Mac/Windows/Web and matches backend authorization.

Tenant-aware observability covers outbox/lag/push/pull/retry/error/conflict/replay, reconnect, bytes/rows, DB/pool latency, client/protocol/domain versions, auth/session/device failures, plan usage, provider calls/cost/cache/stream use, blocks/downgrades, throttling/fairness and protected-session impact.
requirements.canonicalOwner: existing runtime/provider telemetry extended for hosted tenant scope

requirements.requirement: Telemetry distinguishes provider outage from DE.PULSE gateway/auth/DB/sync failure rather than collapsing all degraded states.

Object/function authorization negatives, fairness/noisy-neighbor protection, bounded resource quotas, backpressure, circuit breakers, load shedding and service-edge protections are proven under realistic multi-user load.
Pre-market, regular and after-hours are protected Tier-0 sessions; background sync/maintenance yields/preempts/checkpoints before decision support degrades.

Adversarial closure exercises revocation, product/right downgrade, cross-tenant cache/stream isolation, secret compromise rotation, PostgreSQL failover/PITR/restore, old-client rejection, replay/reconnect, provider/gateway/DB/sync failure and protected-session capacity.
Operator runbooks are assistant/developer independent and hosted-risk changes support bounded canary/kill-switch/progressive activation where applicable.
Institutional/13F evidence becomes a point-in-time provenance-safe foundation before adaptive use.
13F revisions/amendments and historical queries preserve no-lookahead truth.
Two-sided Long/Short thesis evidence substrate (TDTI foundation) preserves independent bull/bear evidence, contradiction and provenance.
TDTI quality/explanation explicitly represents contradiction and unknowns without replacing deterministic truth.
AODR candidate/ranking lineage is reproducible and provenance-bound over canonical Opportunity Radar inputs.
AODR outcome/evaluation lineage is point-in-time safe and contains no execution/P&L ownership.
ADR-GDI professional reliability defines measured SLO/capacity/failure taxonomy and protected-session budgets.
requirements.canonicalOwner: ADR-GDI reliability layer over existing runtime owners

requirements.requirement: ADR-GDI degradation/failover/runbooks/canary controls are executable without creating parallel routing/freshness/subscription ownership.
Specialized/paid provider gaps are evaluated by capability and measured quality/rights/cost need.
Provider upgrade/replace thresholds use evidence from quality, reliability, rights and cost rather than provider count or brand preference.
v20 begins only after trustworthy point-in-time evidence/outcome history, lineage, calibration prerequisites and deterministic-owner boundaries pass readiness audit.
Adaptive Research Control Plane consumes canonical trustworthy evidence and cannot own provider routing, sync, rights or deterministic market truth.
Immutable experiment/evidence/outcome ledger supports reproducible adaptive evaluation.
Model/prompt/version registry, champion/challenger and SHADOW evaluation are reproducible and auditable.
Adaptive production influence requires explicit human-approved promotion/rollback/kill controls; no silent self-modification.
Calibration includes false positives/negatives, misses, contradictions, abstention and drift rather than confidence-only scoring.
ASBI remains a named future workstream; exact expanded semantics freeze only at G0 from source/issue truth, with rights/provenance eligibility before inference.
ASBI follows SHADOW evaluation, calibration/outcomes, explanation/correlation/contradiction/abstention and controlled promotion before closure.
Adaptive Institutional/13F features begin SHADOW-first and use point-in-time v19 lineage/outcome evidence.
Adaptive TDTI preserves two-sided evidence, contradiction/confidence calibration and abstention before controlled production influence.
Adaptive AODR remains layered over canonical Opportunity Radar with SHADOW ranking, outcome learning, regime context, explanation/abstention and controlled promotion.
Adaptive ADR-GDI may recommend degradation/fallback/provider usefulness/resource scheduling but Smart Provider Router v2 and protected deterministic owners remain authoritative.
Operational adaptive policy promotion is bounded, human-approved, rollback-capable and learns from drift/incidents without silent self-modification.
U.S. Equities Processing, GLD/SLV/USO actionable exceptions and No Execution remain permanent across v19/v20.

Smart Provider Router v2 remains sole routing owner; canonical freshness/recovery, multi-feed subscription, cache/persistence/state/session/calendar/identity and direct SEC/EDGAR authorities remain reused rather than duplicated.
Adaptive influence follows SHADOW → VALIDATED → APPROVED → PRODUCTION and never invents confidence for missing evidence or silently self-modifies.
Every future slice has one primary responsibility, explicit dependencies/closure criteria and G0 overlap classification before implementation.
Each v19/v20 dependency band ends with no-feature zero-gap closure and cannot advance with UNASSIGNED/unexplained applicable requirements.
This planning slice does not reserve/start a v19 product child; after closure a fresh source-overlap G0/G1 selects the first genuine residual.
